property_mix.era: predominantly pre-1945, with scattered interwar and post-war infill
property_mix.notable: Seaside resort character with significant older residential stock; high proportion of period properties with original or period-style door furniture.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian and Edwardian terraces dominate; original sash windows and period locks require specialist knowledge and careful handling.
Seafront properties in New Brighton and Seacombe face salt-air corrosion; coastal weather accelerates lock and mechanism wear.
High density of older rental stock means frequent tenant turnovers, emergency lockouts, and multipoint lock upgrades for compliance.
